subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Drone Strikes and Kill Lists
description: One-minute skill: Drone Strikes and Kill Lists.

hook.text: A phone's location data triggers a drone strike thousands of miles away. The target is identified by metadata.

buildup.text: The US drone program uses signals intelligence — phone data and communications — to identify targets.

discovery.text: Former NSA director Michael Hayden admitted: 'We kill people based on metadata.' The statement was chilling.

twist.text: Metadata errors have led to strikes on innocent people. A phone's location is not proof of identity.

climax.text: Surveillance data doesn't just watch. In the wrong hands, with wrong assumptions, it kills.

punchline.text: We kill based on metadata. His exact words.

quiz.question: What did former NSA director Hayden admit about the drone program?
options: 'Metadata is never used in targeting decisions'
